title: Wall Mount Paper Towel Holder 15.5-Inch Iron - Pipeline Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your kitchen organization with a wall mount paper towel holder that saves counter space while keeping a roll close at hand.

  • Pipeline collection design with an industrial pipe-inspired look
  • Wall mount installation helps free up countertop space
  • Iron construction with a highly durable powder coat for a clean, decorative finish
  • Color coordinated mounting hardware included
  • Limited lifetime warranty

Specs

  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Material: Iron
  • Overall size: 15.5 in L x 4 in W x 3 in H
  • Projection: 4 in
  • Product weight: 1.3 lb
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
  • Included: Paper towel holder and all installation hardware
  • Assembly required: No

Available in multiple designer finish options to coordinate with other Pipeline collection pieces.

_previous.description: The Pipeline collection is the latest innovation for accessories from the Allied Brass Brand of products. This wall mounted paper towel holder gives the industrial look of pipe fittings while blending aptly with both modern and traditional decor. This accessory is powder coated with lifetime materials to provide a decorative and clean finish. No wonder, this wall mounted paper towel holder gives continual service for years without any trouble. The choice of superior materials makes this item free from corrosion and rust. Paper Towel holder mounts firmly with color coordinating screws and comes with a limited lifetime warranty.
